entities.name: Pierre-Paul de La Grandière
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Paul Marie Benoît de La Grandière was a French admiral who was Governor of the colony of Cochinchina from 1863 to 1868. He consolidated French control over Vietnam as its colony, and developed the city of Saigon as a major port.
